long_biography.plain_text:
Kabbaz trained as an architect at Universidad Anáhuac del Norte and undertook postgraduate studies in real-estate and construction-business administration in Madrid. After completing architectural projects in Mexico City, he joined Grupo Danhos in 1993. His work in designing, developing and managing dense urban projects became central to the expansion of the family property platform founded by his father, David Daniel Kabbaz Chiver.

As chief executive of Fibra Danhos and president of Grupo Danhos, Kabbaz directs a portfolio spanning shopping centres, offices, mixed-use complexes and industrial property. During his operating career, the trust listed publicly and expanded its leasable area substantially, while adding landmark retail and urban projects. He has also served as president of Mexico’s Association of Real Estate Developers and the Mexican Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts. These industry roles reinforce his position as an active operator rather than a passive family shareholder.
